purpose: Bounded proposal-sweep evidence; not a medical evaluation or implementation closeout

experiment_protocols.cause: Five parent ascents rather than four in migrated protocol wrappers

core_temporary_probes.scope: Read-only proposal sweep of common Python workflow and packaging
core_temporary_probes.probes: Existing .venv/bin/python; TemporaryDirectory workspaces; unittest.mock patches for Harbor checksum and subprocess launcher; no real trials, Docker, installs or repository edits

findings.trigger: Study A has verified oracle-pass and nop-fail observations. An issue is recorded against its oracle attempt, giving study A needs_review. Study B has identical task bytes and no issue of its own. Run B without diagnostic.
findings.expected: The questioned control must not authorize nondiagnostic reuse; require replacement evidence or scoped reassessment.
findings.interpretation: Cross-experiment exact-task control reuse is workspace-wide, but the run gate only considers the target experiment assessment. The control selector does not inspect issues, assessments or affected attempts. This does not demonstrate that a real experiment has used an invalid control.

findings.trigger: A completed oracle result is collected, its raw result gains metadata, and it is collected again with unchanged exact-task binding. The old observation remains immutable and the newer observation verifies successfully.
findings.expected: Select the current valid eligible control observation while retaining historical observations; do not let a superseded raw hash veto the newer valid collection.

findings.trigger: Mocked Harbor launcher returns 17 and writes no trial result; invoke CLI run --agent oracle.
findings.expected: Retain the error receipt and return a nonzero operational CLI exit status. A completed model scoring failure should remain a separate outcome.

findings.trigger: Two concurrent calls to new() create distinct experiments in one group. A barrier immediately before atomic_write(group.json) makes both use their previously read membership lists.
findings.expected: The group retains both new experiment IDs or one caller receives an explicit retryable conflict.
findings.interpretation: Atomic replacement prevents torn writes but not lost read-modify-write updates. Missing membership can also omit group-level review flags. No existing record was deleted by this probe.

findings.trigger: Export a temporary Git fixture with recipe mode 0755, then change the packaged script to 0644 and verify it.
findings.expected: Package verification reports the declared executable mode changed.
findings.interpretation: The recipe already declares and the exporter applies modes, so checking that executable contract adds no new metadata system. Verification currently checks inventory and content only.

already_sound: Small installed package and normal imports; inspection consumes explicit metadata locations rather than task payload JSON.
Immutable append-only observations and issue/review events; assistant recommendations do not overwrite accepted decisions.
Exact task snapshots and content checks; diagnostic and controlled execution remain separate.
Importer distinguishes execution errors, partial results, scorer outcomes and contradictory verifier evidence.
Exports use explicit Git/artifact origins, original recipe bytes, fresh destinations and incomplete markers.
Fast offline baseline checks reported by parent: 44 tests with one optional imaging skip; no real trials required.
